summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement with its controlling shareholder, Dragonsoft Holding Limited, for the issuance of 300,000 Class B Ordinary Shares at $1.88 per share, the closing price of Class A shares on September 1, 2026. The shares were issued on September 3, 2026, increasing the buyer's voting power to 91.34% of total voting power. The transaction was exempt under Regulation S and Section 4(a)(2). This is a routine capital raise by an issuer, not a special situation.
